PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Rubber Board, Kottayam (KV Rubber Board Kottayam) Recruitment 2026 for the post of Primary Teacher (PRT) will be conducted through a Walk-in Interview. Eligible candidates can attend the interview on 25 November 2026 at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Rubber Board, Kottayam. For complete details, candidates can visit kvrbkottayam.kvs.ac.in.

PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Rubber Board, Kottayam will hold a walk-in interview for Primary Teachers (PRT) on 25 November 2026 (Wednesday), with the interview scheduled at 10 AM. Candidates must report by 8.30 AM (registration 8.30 – 9.30 AM) at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Rubber Board, Kottayam, PIN 686009. The engagement is purely contractual, on a consolidated pay of Rs. 21,250 per month, and the interview will prepare a panel for the academic year 2026-27.

About KV Rubber Board Kottayam

PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Rubber Board, Kottayam is a school of the Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS) in Kottayam, Kerala (KV Code 1793, CBSE Code 79041, CBSE Affiliation No. 900022). The notice of 21 November 2026, signed by the Principal in charge, invites eligible candidates for engagement as Primary Teachers on a purely contractual basis. The school can be reached on phone 0481-2351807 and by email at [email protected].

Posts and Eligibility

The walk-in is for one post, Primary Teacher (PRT), on a consolidated amount of Rs. 21,250/- per month. The age limit is 18 to 65 years for all posts; the notice prints no cut-off date for age and no age relaxation. The interview prepares a panel, and the notice does not give a number of vacancies.

Essential Qualification

  1. Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary/Intermediate (10+2) with at least 50% marks and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (by whatever name known) from recognized Institute/Board; OR Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary/Intermediate (class XII) with at least 50% marks and 4-years Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.) from recognized Institute/Board; OR Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary/Intermediate/Class-XII with at least 50% marks and 2-years Diploma in Education (Special Education) from Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI).
  2. Qualified in the Central Teacher Eligibility Test Paper-1 conducted by the Govt. of India.
  3. Competence to teach through Hindi & English media.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience of working in a school.
  • Knowledge of Computer application.
  • Working knowledge of English and Hindi.

For detailed eligibility conditions, prescribed qualifications and the application format, the notice refers candidates to the Vidyalaya website https://kvrbkottayam.kvs.ac.in or the detailed notice on the Vidyalaya notice board.

What to Bring

  • All original certificates/testimonials relating to educational qualifications, age and experience.
  • One set of self-attested photocopies of these certificates.
  • One passport size photograph, for scrutiny / submission.

Before the walk-in, candidates must register on the portal https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/ – the notice makes this registration mandatory.

What Happens on the Day

  • Candidates report at 8.30 AM; registration runs from 8.30 to 9.30 AM, and the interview is scheduled at 10 AM.
  • Late comers will not be entertained.
  • Bio-data cum Declaration forms will be provided to the candidates at the venue.
  • The interview is conducted to prepare a panel, which may be operated for the academic year 2026-27 against any vacancy which exist/may arise.
  • Attending the interview or being in the panel does not yield any right for appointment. Final appointment will only be done after further scrutiny of educational qualifications, eligibility criterion etc. at the time of joining as per KVS rules and regulations.

Important Instructions

  • The posts are purely temporary, and appointments, if made, will be on Part Time Contractual basis as per the norms and guidelines of KVS.
  • The engagement does not confer any right to regular appointment in KVS, and selected candidates will not have any claim to be absorbed as regular employees.
  • Teachers appointed on contractual basis will not be entitled for pay during Vacation and Autumn/Winter breaks; payment shall be calculated on pro rata basis for such months.
  • Contract Teachers will not be entitled for pay if they remain absent on a working day; in case of absence from duty, payment will be calculated on pro rata basis.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview.

About Sheikhpura Civil Court Recruitment 2026

The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Sheikhpura, and is signed by Santosh Kumar Tiwary, Principal District and Sessions Judge, Sheikhpura, on 21-11-2026. It engages dedicated supportive staff for the evening Court of Sheikhpura Judgeship, which functions within the Civil Court, Sheikhpura.

Where and How to Send

The application, along with the applicant's willingness and all the documents listed under Enclosures, must reach the following office:

Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Sheikhpura

  • Mode: through registered post or personally (by hand).
  • Deadline: the application must reach the office latest by 21 December 2026, till 05:00 PM. This is a date of receipt, not of dispatch.
  • Application form: the notice does not print an application form or a format; it asks for the application with the applicant's willingness and the enclosures.
  • The notice does not mention any text to be written on the envelope.

Posts, Eligibility and Pay

PostVacanciesPay

The notice prints no salary amount. It states that the period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

Eligibility for All Three Posts

  • The applicant must be a retired Civil Court employee.
  • Only those retired Civil Court employees who have retired within the preceding three years, prior to the period when the selection is being made for such evening courts, or as per the guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court of Judicature at Patna and Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India.
  • The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post.
  • The applicant must possess satisfactory service records.

Who Is Not Eligible

The service-record condition excludes a retired employee:

  • who is facing any vigilance case;
  • against whom any departmental proceedings are pending;
  • against whom any serious charges are pending;
  • against whom any criminal case of any kind is registered;
  • against whom any major punishment has been awarded during the service period.

Stenographer

The applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing in Hindi or English, as the case may be.

Clerk

The applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical work done in Civil Court of both posts, i.e. Office Clerk and Bench Clerk.

Peon/Orderly

The applicant must be capable of performing the duties attached to the post and must have experience of working as Office Attendant and Orderly.

The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification or an age limit for any of the three posts. Candidates should check the official notification for the post-specific eligibility of each post.

Enclosures

The applicant must submit the following documents along with the willingness:

  1. Copy of Pension Payment Order.
  2. Copy of Aadhar Card.
  3. Copy of PAN Card.
  4. An undertaking regarding details of departmental proceeding pending/disposal, if any.

  • The engagement shall not confer any right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

  • Start-up and shutdown of various pumps, blowers and electrical equipment such as Condensate Extraction pumps, Boiler feed pumps, OGDHR pumps and Fans, etc.
  • Start-up of steam water system, feed water heating, TG warm up and rolling, synchronization to GRID and sustained operation of TG set.
  • Assisting and guiding commissioning team during commissioning, testing and integrated operation.

  • Round the clock operation.
  • Monitoring of various plant parameters and operation of equipment in TG, Steam and water system, and auxiliaries.
  • Recording plant parameters within the specified normal range values.

  • Assisting commissioning team during commissioning, testing and integrated operation.

  • Checking mechanical seals, gland packing, bearings and couplings.
  • Perform shaft alignment using dial gauges and laser alignment equipment.
  • Inspect piping, valves, flanges and expansion joints; carry out hydraulic testing and pressure testing wherever required.
  • Identify oil leakage, water leakage and steam leakage; monitor equipment health through vibration and temperature analysis.
  • Check rotor run-out, eccentricity, shaft alignment and bearing clearances; inspect and maintain journal bearings and thrust bearings; check bearing metal temperature, vibration and oil parameters.
  • Monitor differential expansion, axial displacement and rotor eccentricity; inspect gland sealing and labyrinth sealing arrangements.

  • Supervise dismantling, cleaning, and inspection of internal components.
  • Checking and servicing of motor, gearbox, bearings, and seals.
  • Testing of local and remote operation, including control signals; preparation of service and test reports.
  • Inspection, testing & calibration of overload relays and protective relays; checking of control circuits, interlocks, and indication circuits.
  • Functional testing of motor feeders and protection circuits; testing of electrical and mechanical interlocks; troubleshooting of motor starter circuits and control wiring.
  • Preparation of maintenance and test procedures, inspection, and test reports.
  • Power evacuation system maintenance & condition monitoring.
  • Maintenance, troubleshooting, testing and commissioning of the electrical power evacuation system. This covers the Generator, exciter, voltage regulator, Generator Transformer, Unit Auxiliary transformer, Generator circuit breaker, Isolated phase bus duct, Generator relay protection, Generator control panel, overhead conductor, and 6.6 kV vacuum & 230kV SF6 gas insulated breakers, etc.

  • Act as the functional representative for SAP HCM from MOIL's side.
  • Study and document existing HCM processes and facilitate As-Is and To-Be process mapping for S/4HANA with RISE.
  • Coordinate with the HR/Personnel Functional Department, SAP, SAP S/4HANA Consultancy and the SI.
  • Review and validate HCM configuration, functional specifications and proposed solutions submitted by the SI.
  • Coordinate employee master data, organisational structure, payroll-related and other relevant data migration activities.
  • Participate in integration testing, UAT, defect resolution and business-process validation.
  • Coordinate user training, preparation/review of user manuals and knowledge-transfer activities.
  • Support cutover, Go-Live and post-Go-Live stabilization.
  • Monitor HCM-related issues, action points and deliverables and provide regular updates to concerned stakeholders.

SAP FICO Functional Consultant – 1 FTE

  • Act as the functional representative for SAP FICO from MOIL's side.
  • Analyse existing Finance and Controlling processes and facilitate As-Is and To-Be process mapping.
  • Coordinate with the Finance Functional Department, SAP, SAP S/4HANA Consultancy and the SI.
  • Review and validate FICO configuration, functional specifications and proposed solutions.
  • Coordinate financial data migration, data validation and financial reconciliation activities.
  • Ensure appropriate integration of FICO with MM, SD, PM, PP and HCM.
  • Provide functional support for relevant Funds Management (FM) and Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) processes, wherever applicable.
  • Participate in testing, UAT, defect resolution and business-process validation.
  • Coordinate user training, cutover, Go-Live and post-Go-Live stabilization.
  • Monitor FICO-related issues and ensure timely resolution in coordination with the SI and other stakeholders.

SAP MM Functional Consultant – 1 FTE

  • Act as the functional representative for SAP MM from MOIL's side.
  • Analyse procurement, purchasing, inventory, stores and material-management processes.
  • Coordinate with the Materials/Procurement & Stores Functional Department, SAP, SAP S/4HANA Consultancy and the SI.
  • Facilitate As-Is and To-Be process mapping and review proposed S/4HANA solutions.
  • Review material master, vendor master and related data migration activities.
  • Validate MM configuration, functional specifications, workflows and integration requirements.
  • Coordinate integration with FICO, PM, PP and other relevant modules.
  • Participate in testing, UAT, defect resolution and data validation.
  • Support user training, documentation, cutover and Go-Live activities.
  • Provide post-Go-Live support and coordinate resolution of MM-related issues.

SAP PM Functional Consultant – 1 FTE

  • Act as the functional representative for SAP PM from MOIL's side.
  • Analyse existing mining, plant and equipment maintenance processes and facilitate As-Is and To-Be process mapping.
  • Coordinate with the Engineering/Maintenance Functional Department, SAP, SAP S/4HANA Consultancy and the SI.
  • Review functional requirements relating to equipment, functional locations, maintenance plans, work orders and breakdown/preventive maintenance.
  • Review and validate PM configuration and functional specifications prepared by the SI.
  • Coordinate equipment, asset, maintenance master data and related migration activities.
  • Ensure integration with MM, FICO and PP.
  • Participate in testing, UAT, defect resolution and business-process validation.
  • Support user training, cutover, Go-Live and post-Go-Live stabilization.
  • Coordinate resolution of maintenance-related issues with the SI and concerned business users.

SAP SD Functional Consultant – 1 FTE

  • Act as the functional representative for SAP SD from MOIL's side.
  • Analyse existing sales and marketing processes and facilitate As-Is and To-Be process mapping.
  • Coordinate with the Marketing/Sales Functional Department, SAP, SAP S/4HANA Consultancy and the SI.
  • Handle functional requirements relating to customer master, sales orders, pricing, delivery, billing and related processes.
  • Review and validate SD configuration, functional specifications and proposed solutions.
  • Coordinate customer master and transaction-data migration and validation.
  • Ensure appropriate integration with FICO, MM and other relevant modules.
  • Participate in testing, UAT, defect resolution and business-process validation.
  • Support user training, cutover, Go-Live and post-Go-Live stabilization.
  • Monitor SD-related issues and coordinate timely resolution with the SI.

SAP PPQM Functional Consultant – 1 FTE

The notice's vacancy table names this post SAP PP – Production Planning. Its scope of responsibilities is headed SAP PPQM.

  • Act as the functional representative for SAP PPQM from MOIL's side.
  • Analyse existing production and mining-related processes and facilitate As-Is and To-Be process mapping.
  • Coordinate with the Production/Mining Functional Department, SAP, SAP S/4HANA Consultancy and the SI.
  • Handle requirements relating to production planning, production orders, Material Requirements Planning (MRP) and other relevant PP processes.
  • Review and validate PP & QM configuration, functional specifications and proposed solutions.
  • Coordinate production-related master data and migration activities.

  • Participate in integration testing, UAT, defect resolution and business-process validation.
  • Support user training, documentation, cutover and Go-Live activities.
  • Provide post-Go-Live stabilization support and coordinate resolution of PP & QM related issues.

Role in the SAP S/4HANA with RISE implementation (all posts)

The notice says the FTEs shall primarily ensure that:

  • MOIL's business requirements are correctly captured and addressed.
  • Existing business processes are properly reviewed and mapped to S/4HANA with RISE.
  • Proposed configurations and solutions are reviewed from the business perspective.
  • Data migration and validation activities are properly coordinated.
